name: Air Tractor AT-400/500/800
variants: AT-802 / AT-802A (incl. Fire Boss amphibious firefighter)
summary: The dominant US family of single-engine agricultural and firefighting aircraft, mostly turboprop-powered.

wings: Long, straight constant-chord low wing with squared tips
Spray booms along the trailing edge
engines: Long turboprop nose with exhaust stacks (radial on the oldest piston versions)
fuselage: Large chemical hopper ahead of the cockpit
Single-seat (some two-seat) enclosed cockpit set high behind the hopper
Fixed tailwheel gear with spring-steel main legs
tail: Tall angular fin with a large rudder
Wire-cutter cable from cockpit roof to the fin

tellTales: Single-engine low-wing taildragger with a hopper in front of a high-set cockpit
Spray booms along the wing trailing edge
Long turboprop nose with exhaust stacks

confusedWith.howToTell: The Air Tractor usually shows a longer, higher-aspect-ratio wing and a leaner look; the Thrush appears shorter and stockier with a tall, boxy multi-pane cockpit canopy.
